description.en: Belajar is a landing page for online course platforms, e-learning products, and bootcamps: present the course catalog and mentors, share graduate stories, compare membership plans, and collect sign-ups for a free lesson.
description.id: Belajar adalah landing page untuk platform kursus online, produk e-learning, dan bootcamp: tampilkan katalog kursus dan mentor, bagikan cerita lulusan, bandingkan paket keanggotaan, dan kumpulkan pendaftar pelajaran gratis.
